parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.phone, c.website, c.linkedin_url, c.stage, c.enrichment, COALESCE(s.priority_weight, 5) AS priority_weight FROM leads.candidates c LEFT JOIN leads.segments s ON s.id = c.segment_id WHERE c.duplicate_of IS NULL AND c.stage IN ('enriched','qualified','disqualified') ORDER BY c.id

UPDATE leads.candidates c SET qualification_score = s.score, qualification = s.qual, qualified_at = CASE WHEN s.new_stage = 'qualified' THEN COALESCE(c.qualified_at, now()) ELSE NULL END, stage = s.new_stage, stage_updated_at = CASE WHEN c.stage IS DISTINCT FROM s.new_stage THEN now() ELSE c.stage_updated_at END FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS s(id bigint, score integer, new_stage text, qual jsonb) WHERE c.id = s.id

WITH cleared AS (UPDATE leads.candidates SET shortlist_rank = NULL WHERE (stage <> 'qualified' OR duplicate_of IS NOT NULL) AND shortlist_rank IS NOT NULL RETURNING id), ranked AS (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY qualification_score DESC, id ASC) AS rn FROM leads.candidates WHERE stage = 'qualified' AND duplicate_of IS NULL) UPDATE leads.candidates c SET shortlist_rank = r.rn FROM ranked r WHERE c.id = r.id AND c.shortlist_rank IS DISTINCT FROM r.rn

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'qualified') AS qualified, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'disqualified') AS disqualified, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'enriched') AS still_enriched, max(shortlist_rank) AS shortlist_size FROM leads.candidates

parameters.content:
## Lead Qualification Engine v1

Hourly: deterministically scores every candidate in stage enriched/qualified/disqualified using qual_v1 weights (contactability + segment priority), persists score + factor breakdown to leads.candidates.qualification_score / qualification, transitions stage (qualified >= 55 with email; disqualified if no email and no phone), and recomputes leads.candidates.shortlist_rank (score DESC, id ASC) for the outreach shortlist.

Scoring is pure and reproducible: same inputs always produce the same scores and shortlist order. Segment weights live in leads.segments.priority_weight.
